pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions with moderately sharp edge gradients. Geometries vary from quadrangular to hexagonal with dark brown interior saturation and slight pixel-level softening at the perimeter boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a topological lattice. Pathways exhibit relatively uniform pixel width with clear tri-nodal and tetra-nodal junctions separating the dark patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude serrated contour along the dorsal neck and shoulder, characterized by short, dark hair bundles creating a repetitive, jagged silhouette against the background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Multiple discontinuities in the mane line caused by the presence of perched avian organisms and natural structural variations in hair density.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small avian organisms (likely oxpeckers) perched along the dorsal ridge and the lateral neck surface.
